description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kaluwarippuwa-East, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510072
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels (Nos. 143, 144, and 100), including details of ownership, extent, location, and title classification. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land property registration and title settlement, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
